candidates.title: Tesla opens Robotaxi rides in Fort Worth, a fourth Texas city
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Official account set a Monday 6 a.m. start and a downtown geofence, with no vehicle count, safety-monitor status, or price; the same report cites a 1,204-vehicle Texas roster

candidates.title: Tesla sends Cybercab on a 12-stop Europe display tour
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Display-only tour starts in Zürich on Nov 5 and runs into January; Tesla offers no rides, sales, or European robotaxi date

candidates.title: Oracle reports an FSD v14.3.13 crash and regression videos
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Published Nov 2 as a supervised v14.3.13 crash plus regressions; the article body did not render on fetch, so the claim is the headline only

candidates.title: FSD supervised fleet counter passes 17 billion miles
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Live safety page showed about 17.003 billion supervised miles and 6.76 billion city miles, only a few hundred million above the late-October print, and still driver-supervised

candidates.title: RDW cuts Tesla Assisted Driving speed margin from +50% to +10%
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Dutch type approval stays in force, but the offset cap falls to +10%, resets to 0% at startup, and applies to HW4 cars in the countries that already recognize the approval

candidates.title: Korean consumer group plans a KFTC complaint over FSD sold to cars that cannot use it
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Draft complaint asks the Fair Trade Commission to halt marketing of a 9.043 million won FSD package; Tesla data cited in the report put most 2025 Korean Teslas outside legal FSD use

candidates.title: Germany October Tesla registrations jump 290.9% to 2,932
candidates.whyItMightMatter: KBA October print is 2,932 and year-to-date is 47,742, but BYD still led the month and sits 219 units ahead for the year

candidates.title: Giga Texas reportedly adds a night shift and skips holiday shutdowns
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Drone observer says two 12-hour shifts through year-end; Tesla has not confirmed it, and the report says Cybercab may not be the line that can absorb the extra output

candidates.title: Tesla opens a Berlin engineering center with about 250 staff
candidates.whyItMightMatter: BTEC opened Nov 4 near Giga Berlin with four sites consolidated, cell and powertrain labs, and a phase-two ask toward roughly 500 people; it is not a new 4680 output figure

candidates.title: Cybertruck Premium sticker rises to $92,490 and Dual Motor is grayed out
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Premium is up $7,500 from the August sticker and Cyberbeast is $102,490; Dual Motor lists at $82,490 but is no longer selectable, with no Tesla explanation

candidates.title: Musk says Cybertruck production winds down mid-2027 to free space for Cybercab
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Musk gave no volume, hard stop, or Cybercab add; Cybertruck lead Wes Morrill said parts and service continue

candidates.title: Musk says the Austin research fab could cut a chip cycle from a year to a month
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Nov 6 Baron chat restates a 1 TW Terafab goal and says successful Austin research processes would move to Grimes County; he also preferred renting Optimus and floated 5x human productivity

candidates.title: USPTO publishes Tesla underactuated robot-hand cable application
candidates.whyItMightMatter: US 2026/0346473 A1 describes one floating cable per two-joint finger and never names Optimus; it is a 2022-priority filing, not a production or ship-date claim

candidates.title: Tesla sets an Argentina market launch for November 20
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Tesla and Tesla Latinoamérica named Nov 20, but posted no prices, order page, or which models go on sale that day

candidates.title: A production Tesla Semi takes the first Long Beach v4 megawatt charge
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Forum Mobility says a customer's production Semi used two v4 MCS stalls on Nov 5 and claims reservations for more than 330 Semis; Tesla did not disclose a delivery count
